statement: In cvrp_ruin_recreate_dual at 500 ms, coupling a stagnation-adaptive rank-power exponent on score_ruin_nodes (lower p early for broad diversification, higher p late for greedy worst-removal focus) with a score_recreate_action that adds a mild depot-distance / route-tightness gate will reduce mean objective on dev_24 hetero suite relative to the current SBS 16.0597, with the gain concentrated in the weak regimes n=100, uniform spatial, eccentric depot and loose capacity.
rationale: KB method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 shows the multiplicative gate x rank-power score_i = rank_power(|removal_savings|/scale * gates, p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio)) beat the L3 worst-removal control on blind_120 (23.3186 vs 23.3474) and is complementary per-instance; archive weakest regimes here are size=100, uniform spatial, eccentric depot, loose capacity, all with negative vbs_rel_gap and 100% exhausted instances, suggesting the ruin set selection is the binding constraint on larger uniform instances where route loads are less binding and geometric/route-tightness diversity matters more.

statement: In cvrp_ruin_recreate_dual at 500 ms, coupling a stagnation-adaptive rank-power exponent on score_ruin_nodes (lower p early for broad diversification, higher p late for greedy worst-removal focus) with a score_recreate_action that adds a mild depot-distance / route-tightness gate will reduce mean objective on dev_24 hetero suite relative to the current SBS 16.0597, with the gain concentrated in the weak regimes n=100, uniform spatial, eccentric depot and loose capacity.
rationale: Round-4 frozen solver session_r0004_cvrp_ruin_recreate_dual_03512c24 scored mean_tour_length 16.088743 on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 (24/24 feasible, completion_rate 1.0, solve_ms_mean 364.7 ms), i.e. +0.0291 (+0.18%) WORSE than the current portfolio SBS 16.059704 and only a marginal +0.0114 gain over round-3's 16.1001. The predicted regime-concentrated gain (n=100 uniform / eccentric depot / loose capacity) therefore did not materialise: the hypothesis is refuted in its stated form (reduction vs SBS 16.0597). Diagnosis: the evolved hook stacked four coupled components — normalized removal_savings, savings/route_dist 'length_share', savings/route_load 'load_share', and a NEGATIVE depot-distance relative term rel_term = -depot_dist_norm*(0.25+2*demand_frac) whose weight grew with stagnation_ratio (0.05+1.6*stagg+0.9*iter_frac). Because late-stage and stagnation states consequently dominated the ruin-set ranking by depot distance and by savings/load ratio, the destroy set drifted toward high-demand far-peripheral customers that deterministic Regret-2 reinsertion simply puts back into (nearly) the same route position, wasting the perturbation budget. This matches the r0001 SBS being strongest (22/24 wins, mean 16.0597) and confirms that on this hetero suite the L3 multiplicative-gate/rank-power recipe from KB method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 does NOT transfer automatically to the dual-hook template: it needs the recreation side to be genuinely complementary (adaptive insertion-cost perturbation / blinks) rather than a re-weighted ruin ranking.
